title: Deep learning on the ECG estimates right ventricular size and function
summary: A deep learning model on 12-lead ECGs predicted right ventricular dilation and dysfunction. For RV dysfunction, AUROC was 0.86 (UK Biobank), 0.81 (original) and 0.77 (validation) cohorts; for RV dilation 0.91, 0.81 and 0.92. Predicted RVEF was independently associated with a composite outcome over 2.3 years median follow-up (HR 1.37 per 10% decrease, p=0.046). RV dysfunction prevalence in UK Biobank was only 1.0%. Preprint of 2023-04-26.
